# Sundhedsstyrelsen

Sundhedsstyrelsen (the Danish Health Authority) appears in the ADHD_2024 annual report documentation as the national body responsible for approving diagnostic competencies within Denmark's healthcare system. Specifically, it has approved the inclusion of Specialpsykologer (specialist psychologists) as clinicians authorized to make psychiatric diagnoses within the ADHD quality database (RKKP ADHD) [^src1]. According to the source material, Sundhedsstyrelsen, together with Danske Regioner (Danish Regions), has raised no objections or reservations regarding which diagnoses Specialpsykologer are permitted to make [^src2].

This matters because the broader context concerns a technical appendix documenting calculation rules and population definitions for Denmark's nationwide ADHD database, which tracks both children, young people, and adults diagnosed with ADHD across two main patient populations: an assessment (udredning) population and a treatment (behandling) population. Several Danish regions submitted feedback on their performance against various quality indicators, citing registration problems, implementation challenges, and a need to revise certain indicators. Notably, Region Sjælland specifically requested that Specialpsykologer be included in the diagnostic criterion for indicator 3, grounding this request in their legally established (lovfæstede) competencies to make psychiatric diagnoses. Sundhedsstyrelsen's approval, alongside that of Danske Regioner, is cited as the regulatory basis supporting this inclusion, with the source material explicitly noting there are no reservations to be raised on this point within RKKP ADHD [^src1].

- Page 69: "Dette er beskrevet og godkendt af Sundhedsstyrelsen samt Danske Regioner, og der er ikke forbehold at tage ift. punktet i RKKP ADHD." [^src1]
- Page 69: "Der tages fra Sundhedsstyrelsen og Danske Regioner ikke forbehold ift. hvilke diagnoser Specialpsykologer kan diagnosticere." [^src2]
